prompt_transform.guidance: For short video, make the first beat a visual promise, not only a verbal topic.
prompt_transform.template: Intent: open with a visible promise around {subject}; the first image tells viewers why to keep watching.

negative_constraints: Do not start with abstract explanation if a visual beat can carry the hook.
Do not overpromise a scene the node cannot generate.
quality_checks: The hook can be seen within the first shot.
The opening beat matches the target platform.

source_refs.label: Google Cloud Veo prompting guide
source_refs.note: Structured prompts combine subject, action, context, and ambiance.

prompt_transform.guidance: Compress each beat to one visible change: reveal, reaction, reversal, proof, or transition.
prompt_transform.template: Action/Beat: compress {action} into a short-video beat with one visible change.

negative_constraints: Do not include long exposition inside a visual generation prompt.
Do not ask one beat to solve setup, conflict, and resolution at once.
quality_checks: Beat is short enough for one node or shot.

source_refs.label: Runway Academy Prompting Guide
source_refs.note: Generative media prompting benefits from clear visual direction and iteration.

prompt_transform.guidance: Use dialogue only when it supports visible behavior, character reveal, or pacing.
prompt_transform.template: Action/Beat: dialogue supports {action}; visual behavior remains primary.

negative_constraints: Do not rely on dialogue alone to explain visual story.
Do not create text-heavy prompts for image or keyframe nodes.
quality_checks: The prompt still works without perfect lip-sync.

source_refs.label: DeepMind Veo prompt guide
source_refs.note: Dialogue is one prompt element among framing, style, lighting, character, location, and action.

prompt_transform.guidance: Favor fast visual readability: clear subject, readable action, and uncluttered frame hierarchy.
prompt_transform.template: Intent: make {subject} readable immediately for short-video viewing.

negative_constraints: Do not depend on small text or subtle background clues.
Do not create dense multi-character blocking unless required.
quality_checks: Main subject is readable on mobile.
Frame hierarchy is simple enough for short-form pacing.
